title: Sayyidina Muhammad (s) is a Ruby and We Are Stones
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) As-salaamu `alaykum! Yaa `IbaadAllah, yaa `IbaadAllah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa
ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
Allahuma salli wa sallim barik `alaa Sayyidi ‘l-Awwaleen wa ‘l-Akhireen, habeebu ‘l-Rabbee ‘l-`alameen,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s) wa aalihi wa sahbihi ajma`een. Zidhu yaa Rabbee nooran wa suroora wa ridwaana
sultaan. Yaa Allah, yaa Allah, yaa Allah! Anta Rabbee! Anta Rabbuna! Anta Rasoolullah! Rabbana wa ‘ilayk ‘lmaseer. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Thumma as-salaam `alaa jami` ‘l-awliyaa min ahlu ‘s-samawaati wa ’l-`ard. Zid-hu yaa Rabbee, `izzan wa
sharafan, nooran wa surooran. salaamullahi wa barakaatuhu wa ridwaanahu `alaa ‘l-mu'mineen wa ‘lmu’minaat wa ‘l-muslimeena wa ‘l-muslimaat. Yaa Rabbee!
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa
ayyuha ‘l-mu'minoon wa ‘l-muslimoon! And we are saying, “A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.”

Shaytan makes people dishonored in the Divine Presence. Don't follow Shaytan! We are asking Allah
Almighty to give His heavenly protection to His weak servants, and His forgiveness and blessings. Holy honor
is for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, who is the most beloved, most ta`zeem, glorified among all Creation,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s). It is such an honor for us to be from his nation!
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Always say, “A`oodhu billahi
min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem,” so Shaytan doesn’t come to you; also, to recite, “Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem” is a heavenly sword granted from Allah Almighty (swt).
O People! Ask for the highest honor in the Divine Presence. Allah Almighty created 124,000 prophets and
asked them, "What are you asking? I am granting you the honor of prophecy." About being prophets they
said, "Yes, we are accepting." Then Allah Almighty spoke His Holy, Divine Words to the prophets, regarding
the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) When they
saw what was granted to ummati Muhammad (s), so full of honor here and Hereafter, they said, "O our Lord!
Let us be his weak followers or even one person from his nation!” Sorrow or bad luck is for those people who
have not been been granted to be a person from the nation of the Seal of Prophets (s)!. (Mawlana Shaykh
stands and sits)
The Lord of Heavens said, "Yes, I granted you the honor to be My prophets for My servants; now you are
dressed in that honor, but you are asking to be an ordinary person from the nation of Sayyidina Muhammad
(s). I accept this and grant you that honor, but you are also going to be prophets as I dressed you and honored
you to be prophets for Mankind.”
Allah (swt) said, “I am only accepting one, Jesus Christ, Sayyidina `Isa (a), to be from among the nation of
My most beloved servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).” (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) “I granted this to
him and when the Last Day approaches, I will send him to be from My most beloved servant’s nation at the
end of the world, and for forty years he will follow My Last Prophet, My Beloved One’s Shari`ah, the
commands I ordered.”
Sayyidina `Isa (a) will come at the end of the world, not as a prophet but, as he asked, to be one of his
ummah. He will be one person from the nation of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad al-Akhireen. I
am sorry for all religious people and nations that were granted holy books, like Moses' tribes and Jesus

Christ's nation, who are not following the holy commands from the Lord of Heavens to Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
You must stand up for his honor! He came from Meccatu 'l-Mukarrama, the first holy place on Earth, the
House of the Lord! When he was invited to make a heavenly visit to the Lord of Heavens, he came from the
first House of the Lord to Jerusalem and 124,000 prophets all stood and saluted him! (Mawlana Shaykh
stands and sits) Which prophet was granted that? Say, Pope! Say to me! Say, Rabbis! Where are you (on this
topic)? Are you finding this in your holy books? Alhamdulillah, his nation was on their feet, for the honor of
the Last Prophet's honor!
And we are just honored, but I am sorry to say first, the Arabs are not giving real respect to the Seal of
Prophets (s) to keep his Shari`ah. They are running away, not giving real respect to his constitution! Ptuu
(spit) on them! Those Arabs are leaving holy shari`atullah and trying to make a constitution of no real value,
throwing away a diamond and asking to take a stone!
(Mawlana Shaykh sings) The ruby is dark red. You must know among yourselves, even among all prophets,
what is the value of the Seal of Prophets (s). Huwa ‘l-makut, he is a ruby and we are stones. It is only granted
to those who are believers and followers of the Seal of Prophets (s) to be rubies, but their ruby is not going to
be like his, which is from the Lord of Heavens granted to him during the Night Journey, while the others are
from Earth.
Now Arabs are asking to follow shaytanic ways, saying, "We must make a parliament." May Allah make your
parliament fall on your heads and all of you die! They are still not giving real respect to their prophet’s orders,
which are from Heaven and written in the Holy Qur’an. Allah Almighty is saying, "O My most beloved one!
Don't worry. I will teach them a lesson and give them good training. The angels of fire are going to make
them good rubies!" But they will be in need for thousands and millions of years to be on that fire, to be real
rubies. That is granted to them through their lives on Earth, but they refuse it.
I am sorry Arabs are saying (with false pride), "We are Arabs!" Nationalism is a curse from the Heavens, as
addressed in the message of the Seal of Prophets (s). They are asking, "Which constitution should we follow?
We don't know." Libyans, Palestinians, Syrians, and Turks are all asking to follow a constitution. The

Russians, Germans, French, and Italians may do that, but we Muslims have been granted heavenly laws,
Shari`ah. It is the biggest shame for Turks, Kurdish, and Arabs to leave the Holy Shari`ah, to say, “We are
going to find this (new way) to bring to people." Fear Allah! Allah Almighty already sent Holy Qur’an! Those
were His orders, but you don't like it, He (swt) is saying, "I am going to train them, to teach them a lesson!"
Therefore, now a heavenly whip is coming first on Arabs. Egypt is claiming, "We are the center of Islam, with
the highest position of Islam in our country." How are you saying this and you are looking to make a new
constitution, asking to write this and that (implement new laws to govern the people). Let them take it and
(...)! (Laughter) I am a very weak servant, but Allah (swt) gave us an unseen Creation, viruses, that He may
send on them instead of the ababeel He sent on the tyrant Abraha of Yemen (Holy Qur’an 105:1-5).
Once upon a time in Basra, people were in a bad condition of disobedience, so Allah Almighty sent the plague
on them. In one day, 70,000 passed away, on the second day 73,000, and the third day 75,000. The Lord of
Heavens was not bombarding them with a plane or a missile, no. On the fourth day, the great city of Basra
was closed; you couldn't find one person to open the door to his house, and from thousands of houses you
couldn't find a living person to come out! Allah!
O Arabs! You are saying, "We are Arabs," but you must instead say, "We are Muslims!" Palestinians, Iraqis,
Shami, Palestinians, Turkis Saudi, Libians, leave your nationalist titles and say, “We are Muslims!” and Allah
Almighty will send His heavenly blessings on you. Say, "We are your servants, O Allah! We are servants of the
Lord." Until you return to Shari`ah, perhaps 10 million Arabs must pass away, 20 million Turks, 30 million
Asians, and 50 million from Pakistan! We are asking forgiveness.
O People! Daily you should say, “Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah.” Divine punishment will come
first on men and secondly on women, because men allow their women to show their beauty and ornaments in
public, dressing daily in new fashions. Are you (women) asking to be mannequins for these new fashions, or
to show your bodies? For what? Shaytan is making new fashions for you, saying, "Now winter is coming and
you need new clothes." What about the old ones? They throw them away. Now the Greeks are bankrupt and
after a while, Europe will also be bankrupt. For what? (They spend too much) and their citizens are so poor!
O Mankind! That is a declaration, a warning to you from the Lord of Heavens, Who warns His people any
way He likes; He may use ants!

Qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuha 'n-namlu 'dkhuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaymaanu wa
junooduhoo wa hum laa yash`uroon. One of the ants said, "O Ants! Enter your homes unless Sulayman and
his armies unknowingly trample you. (an-Naml, 27:18)
That is a big lesson for Mankind! Allah Almighty is not saying, "Come out." He is saying, “Leave all the roads
empty, don't come out! If there is fitna and corruption, enter your homes.” Don't be a target for those people
who are not keeping haqqullah, Allah Almighty's orders.
Allah Almighty said:
••••• ••••••••••• •••••••••••
Wa laa taqtuloo anfusakum. Nor kill (or destroy) yourselves. (An-Nisa, 4:29)
"Don't kill your people." Saleh (President of Yemen), Bashar (President of Syria), the Turks, and in so many
countries they are killing, but for what? Allah (swt) said, "Don't kill," but they are disobedient!
O People! Heavenly revenge is coming and Allah Almighty will make everything clear. It is not good to protest
in the streets, “Irhaal, irhaal, irhaal, go out (Mubarak)!” It is better to go to your village homes and leave the
cities empty so they will ask, “Where are all the people? No one is here!” Don't make yourselves a target so
they can kill you. They lost Islam; the Muslims are ignorant, not learning Shari`atullah. Everything they do is
against Holy Shari`ah and yet they say, “Irhaal, irhaal yaa Bashar!” He is not going away until something
comes on him from the Heavens. When Allah Almighty orders, the tyrants will be sent away, but not until the
people say, “Tawbah, yaa Allah!” No one blamed ababeel, the small birds that bombarded and killed Abraha.
Keep your adab and your imaan though Shari`atullah, and Shari`ah will protect you! If not, you will be
punished here and Hereafter.
May Allah (swt) forgive us and protect us for the sake of Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.

If anyone says, "That old man, that old servant, is saying wrong things," and it is true, Allah may take my
soul. If it is not true, Sayyidina Azra’eel may take his soul.
Fatihah.
That is a warning to all Mankind, and to me also. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa
Rabbee! Shukran yaa Rabbee, shukran yaa Rabbee, shukran yaa Rabbee!
Fatihah.
